text: {"lessons":["Selling winners quickly can feel satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should follow a consistent portfolio plan.","My average cost and reluctance to admit a mistake are not evidence about a stock’s future, so I should assess each holding on its merits.","With prices moving randomly, repeated checking and trading can create needless activity; I should avoid reacting to noise and make changes only for a clear reason."]}
